# S54 — Tests inherit enclosing project state when temporary directories are inside the workspace

**Findings:** S52 validation; three failures with workspace-local TMPDIR · **Size: S** · **Tree:** tests

**Not in this slice:** changing slicer root discovery or weakening assertions to accept inherited state.

## Why

Running the suite with TMPDIR inside this checkout causes two outside-project tests to discover the enclosing .slicer directory, and a not-a-Git-repository test to discover its Git repository. S52 validation ran 443 tests with these three failures. Workspace-restricted contributors need an isolated way to run the suite.

## Files

 tests/support.py; tests/test_cli.py; tests/test_errors.py; AGENTS.md.

## Failing tests

The outside-project and not-a-Git-repository tests should retain their intended meaning when temporary directories live beneath a slicer/Git project.

## Implement

Provide test isolation for parent-project discovery without changing production discovery semantics. Document how to run the suite within a workspace boundary.

## Check

Run the full suite with temporary directories inside the checkout and confirm isolation, including the three previously failing cases.
